textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® E3900 (“Apollo Lake-I“)

The Embedded BoxPC MBox-V-E39, powered by the Intel Atom® E3900 series (Apollo Lake-I), is a versatile and compact solution designed for various embedded applications. With a small footprint, this PC offers flexibility in hardware integration and chassis design, making it suitable for desktop use or DIN rail mounting in cabinets. The MBox-V-E39 can be tailored to meet individual configuration needs, allowing for easy addition of functionality and interfaces through internal Mini PCIe add-in cards.

Equipped with up to 8 GB of DDR3L memory, two Gbit Ethernet ports, and two USB 3.0 ports, this system provides high-speed I/O capabilities. It also features two Mini DisplayPort connectors for connecting high-resolution monitors, making it ideal for applications requiring visual output.

With optional TPM 1.2/2.0 support, extended temperature range, and preparedness for wireless connectivity, the MBox-V-E39 offers versatility and adaptability. It is well-suited for use in embedded servers, gateway applications, entry-level PC systems for automation and monitoring, and any scenario demanding quality, durability, and long-term availability.

The integration of Intel Atom® E3900 processors ensures efficient and reliable performance, making the MBox-V-E39 a reliable choice for FPGA engineers working on diverse embedded projects

text.text:
Features

  • Efficient Processor: Intel Atom® E3900 series (Apollo Lake-I) ensures reliable and efficient performance for FPGA applications.

  • Versatile Connectivity: Two Gbit Ethernet ports and two USB 3.0 ports offer high-speed I/O options for connecting various peripherals.

  • Visual Output Capabilities: Equipped with two Mini DisplayPort connectors, the system supports dual high-resolution monitors.

  • Customizable Configuration: Internal Mini PCIe add-in cards enable easy expansion and customization of functionality and interfaces.

  • Extended Temperature Support: Optional extended temperature range enhances adaptability for diverse environmental conditions
